tytul: Brine-cured smoked and cooked ham: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for a traditional ham cured in brine, smoked over alder and fruit wood and then cooked in hot water (Polish szynka tradycyjna peklowana na mokro, wędzona i parzona).

ostrzezenia.tekst: UGA recommends cooking products made from ground pork and beef to an internal temperature of 160 °F.
Too much nitrate or nitrite can be toxic to people.

akapity: According to Oklahoma State University Extension, a ham cured and smoked to 142 °F inside needs further cooking at home, and the publication gives no final internal temperature for a home-cured ham.
The UGA rule in the warning above is for products made from ground meat, not for a whole ham.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for a brine-cured, smoked and cooked ham from a checked source.
